Slice 4 landed on origin/main (time conditions on the common path; answers digest in every record). Follow-ups from its reviews, none score-changing:
15. provenance.clockSha256 is written and never read back (clock content is bound by source equality).
16. SceneIntervals.build and ff_time.build check monotonic bounds before clamping the first to 0; a second scene starting at or before clip 0 would give an inverted first interval. Real data clean.
17. No test drives StudyExport.intervals or the agentStudyReplay/agentStudyRecords time refusals through the CLI; partScales uses isDigit (Unicode digits) where the codec decides first.
18. rejudgePlain ignores extra keys in a non-time stated answer (e.g. near on a film answer).
19. The library's clip origin is the first target row; ff_time's is the first row without the title mark. Equal for the FilmFestival exporter by construction; a different exporter could separate them.
